description: This is a Java test source file for the Allergies class in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests verifying the functionality and behavior of the Allergies class, including methods for adding, removing, and managing allergy data, along with validation to prevent duplicates.

classes.name: AllergiesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Allergies class methods and behaviors.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, creating an instance of Allergies and setting up test data.

methods.name: shouldAddAllergyAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests adding allergies and verifying the allergy list updates correctly with appropriate status.

methods.name: shouldAddAllergyCollectionAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests adding a collection of allergies to the Allergies object and verifying correct state and status.

methods.name: shouldRemoveAllergyAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Verifies removal of allergies from the list and correct status update.

methods.name: shouldClearAllergyAndSetCorrectStatus
methods.description: Tests clearing the allergies list and verifying list empties and status resets.

methods.name: shouldConfirmNoKnownAllergies
methods.description: Tests the method to confirm there are no known allergies.

methods.name: shouldThrowAnErrorWhenTryingConfirmNoKnowAllergiesWhileAllergiesIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown if confirming no allergies when list is not empty.

methods.name: add_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests that adding a duplicate coded allergen throws an APIException.

methods.name: add_shouldAllowNonDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Ensures adding different coded allergens does not throw an exception.

methods.name: add_shouldNotAllowDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests that adding duplicate non-coded allergens raises an exception.

methods.name: add_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that different non-coded allergens can be added successfully.

methods.name: add2_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests duplicate addition at specific index throws an exception.

methods.name: add2_shouldAllowNonDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Checks addition of different coded allergens at specific index.

methods.name: add2_shouldNotAllowDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests duplicate non-coded allergen addition at index throws an exception.

methods.name: add2_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies different non-coded allergens can be added at index.

methods.name: addAll_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Testing that adding a collection with duplicate coded allergens triggers an exception.

methods.name: addAll_shouldAllowNonDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Checks that adding a collection with unique coded allergens succeeds.

methods.name: addAll_shouldNotAllowDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate non-coded allergens in a collection produce an exception.

methods.name: addAll_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Ensures that collection of unique non-coded allergens can be added successfully.

methods.name: addAll2_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Tests adding duplicate coded allergens at a specific index throws an exception.

methods.name: addAll2_shouldAllowNonDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies non-duplicate coded allergens can be added at specific index.

methods.name: addAll2_shouldNotAllowDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Checks adding duplicate non-coded allergens at specific index raises an exception.

methods.name: addAll2_shouldAllowNonDuplicateNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Ensures non-duplicate non-coded allergens can be added at index successfully.

methods.name: addAll4_shouldNotAllowDuplicateCodedAllergen
methods.description: Verifies duplicate attribution within an allergy collection raises an exception.

methods.description: Tests duplicate allergens added via list collection at index raises exception.
